headline: Applying the documented rates, merchant exclusions, and round-down rule gives exactly the two gold disputes; the only gap is the rounding doc missing from the required list.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding rule that makes the gold dispute set exact (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not in this task's required_documents, so the golden_retrieval variant never shows it.
evidence: task_021.required_documents does not include doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 (grep: only task_028 lists it)
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval.py build_tools: "# No retrieval tools (no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval)"

doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: Under golden_retrieval the agent cannot search the KB, so it must guess the rounding convention; round-half-up flags 6 extra transactions (ThredUp 50.92, HBO Max 142.55, Spotify 439.92, Tesla Supercharger 48.16x5, Patagonia 161.15x5, DTE 282.82). Search-based configs (default alltools, bm25, etc.) can retrieve doc_007, so headline scores are unaffected.

solution_check: Computed all 17 transactions for d2e5bc4124: Business Bronze 1% with WeWork at 0% (doc_..._business_bronze_rewards_card_003 "WeWork" earns 0%), EcoCard 5/$ Green except ThredUp/Target/Walmart/Amazon. Under floor the only mismatches are txn_ccbb948ffa10 (Chipotle 369.55 -> 369 vs 184) and txn_5b30a52ac9d6 (Everlane Green 270.42x5 = 1352 vs 270), which are the gold. Round-half-up adds 6 false positives.
prior_note: Prior (Major) said the rounding convention was undocumented; doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 states floor rounding, is unchanged since v1.0.0, and reproduces the gold exactly, so that defect never applied to search-based configs. Only the required_documents omission remains.
notes: The Business Bronze new-customer promo (doc_..._010) is a statement credit, not a rate change, and the account opened 08/12/2024, so it does not apply. The persona verifies with DOB + email; gold[0] carries phone/address from db users[d2e5bc4124].
